parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, border/facility ban or police targeting is documented, and discrimination/hate-crime protections provide some recourse, but the decisive traveler-facing exposure is custody: trans women recorded as male are placed in all-male facilities as a legal grey area, with the 2021 preventive mechanism finding persistent serious violations across about 40 cases since 2010. That is a state-imposed tier-1 universal exposure for any detained visitor, with no documented remedy changing the placement. Local religious stigma/coexistence of gender-variant roles, isolation and thin local enforcement/recourse add friction. Resident marker, healthcare, marriage and conversion-therapy rules are not counted as traveler protections. This matches the unremedied custody-exposure tier, not the lower tiers with additional targeting.
